events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: American rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died from his injuries six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: A true icon of the 90s, Tupac's influence on music and culture remains undeniable. Today, we remember his incredible legacy.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Legendary American guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27 due to barbiturate-related asphyxia.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Still mesmerising audiences with his revolutionary guitar work. Remembering the one and only Jimi Hendrix today.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: That iconic cover, those timeless tracks. Celebrating the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: American-British singer-songwriter Chrissie Hynde, best known as the frontwoman of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, lead vocalist of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your top Oasis or solo track?

events.title: 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 29, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' continues to resonate globally with its powerful message of peace. Remembering John Lennon's timeless anthem.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: Remember the iPod?
angles.copy: Cast your mind back! We're thinking about the launch of the original iPod. Did you have one of these game-changers in your pocket?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Iconic English musician, singer, and songwriter John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the profound musical and cultural impact of John Lennon. His legacy lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy.

events.title: 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Revisited
angles.copy: Celebrating the anniversary of The Beatles' sprawling 'White Album'. A truly diverse and experimental masterpiece. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Forever a legend. Today, we remember the unparalleled talent and showmanship of Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: Celebrating a true game-changer in pop music history. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' album turns another year older today!

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was tragically shot and killed in New York City on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this sombre day, we remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away. His music and message of peace continue to inspire the world.
